query: RETURN _hour(local_time('13:47:09')) AS h, _minute(local_time('13:47:09')) AS mi, _second(local_time('13:47:09')) AS s

name: date_part_zoned_datetime
query: RETURN _day(zoned_datetime('2024-03-15T23:30:00+05:00')) AS d, _hour(zoned_datetime('2024-03-15T23:30:00+05:00')) AS h

name: date_part_zoned_time
query: RETURN _hour(zoned_time('01:15:00+02:00')) AS h, _minute(zoned_time('01:15:00+02:00')) AS mi

name: duration_add_pt24h
query: RETURN zoned_datetime('2026-03-07T20:00:00-05:00') + duration('PT24H') AS r

name: duration_add_p1d
query: RETURN zoned_datetime('2026-03-07T20:00:00-05:00') + duration('P1D') AS r
